description: Myanmar Railway Network is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU). Myanmar national rail network (lines). Updated railway data in March 2022 based on Google Satellite images and the Ministry of Transport and Communications. This layer shows the transportation network based on available information from Google Earth. Parts of the network may not be functioning for various reasons such as landslides. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU). Its tags are geodata, natural disasters, transportation. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
